Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount storing ERC20 allowances.
Pure addition helper that requires the result to be >= a, preventing overflow.
Pure subtraction helper that requires b <= a, preventing underflow.
Pure multiplication helper with an overflow sanity require.
Pure division helper requiring a non-zero divisor.

onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.

Constant function returning _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using raw subtraction.
Constant function returning the balance of a given token owner.

Spends an allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to', updating balances and allowed.

Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.

Interface callback invoked by approveAndCall on the spender contract.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, balance/allowance indexing and access checks.
External call to arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval before approveAndCall returns.
External call to an arbitrary ERC20 token contract from an onlyOwner function.
Unchecked raw subtraction of balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply without SafeMath.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner during Owned construction.
msg.sender indexes balances inside transfer.
msg.sender indexes allowed inside approve.
msg.sender is used as the spender key in transferFrom.
msg.sender indexes allowed inside approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to grant ownership.
Owned constructor writes owner.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
AUMToken constructor sets _totalSupply.
AUMToken constructor assigns the full supply to the fixed holder in balances.
AUMToken constructor sets symbol.
AUMToken constructor sets name.
AUMToken constructor sets decimals.
transfer updates balances for sender and recipient.
approve writes the allowance into allowed.
transferFrom updates balances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements the caller allowance in allowed.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed before the external call.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf reads balances for the queried owner.
allowance reads the nested allowed mapping.
transfer delegates subtraction to safeSub.
transfer delegates addition to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates subtraction to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates addition to safeAdd.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the untrusted spender via receiveApproval.
The untrusted callee can re-enter approveAndCall or transferFrom before the caller returns.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary token contract; onlyOwner constrained and no state is written after the call.
totalSupply performs arithmetic directly instead of routing through SafeMath.
Raw subtraction can underflow if balances[address(0)] ever exceeds _totalSupply.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner as the recipient of the foreign tokens.

normalization_plan.reason: transfer.to is the destination parameter of the transfer function and carries no independent state.
transfer.tokens is the amount parameter consumed by safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer.
approve.spender is the key parameter used when writing allowed.
approve.tokens is the value parameter written into the allowance mapping.
transferFrom.from is the source account parameter of transferFrom.
transferFrom.to is the destination account parameter of transferFrom.
transferFrom.tokens is the amount parameter spent in transferFrom.
approveAndCall.spender is the untrusted target of the receiveApproval external call.
approveAndCall.tokens is the approved amount forwarded to the callback.
approveAndCall.data is the payload forwarded to receiveApproval.
transferAnyERC20Token.tokenAddress is the untrusted external contract target.
transferAnyERC20Token.tokens is the amount forwarded to the external transfer call.
transferOwnership._newOwner is the address staged into newOwner.
allowance.tokenOwner is the lookup key of the allowance query.
allowance.spender is the second lookup key of the allowance query.
balanceOf.tokenOwner is the lookup key of the balance query.
receiveApproval.from is a callback parameter delivered by the untrusted caller.
receiveApproval.tokens is a callback parameter delivered by the untrusted caller.
receiveApproval.token is a callback parameter delivered by the untrusted caller.
receiveApproval.data is a callback parameter delivered by the untrusted caller.
